d:
Delhi Police has asked X to remove the accounts of IFF, SFLC and GeoBlockedIndia, along with several posts, over alleged defamation of the RSS. IFF has challenged the notices, questioned their legal basis and threatened to approach the court if they are not withdrawn. The controversy has also triggered a political debate, with Congress leader Pawan Khera criticising the police action.
